records.author: genesis
records.text: The routine work of the office is done by its staff, by the office's standing work orders and only by them. The tasks: collect, at town-hall: The crew collects from each address on the round. The office's own rhythm for it is every 7 days: an order that does not say how often follows that. maintain, at town-hall: The crew keeps up the most worn of the town's assets. The office's own rhythm for it is every 1 day: an order that does not say how often follows that. levy, at rates-office: At each instalment the rating law sets, the clerks send every owner a notice. When it is done is set by law-rates: an order for it says "as law-rates sets" in place of how often, or says nothing of how often.
